city.name: Washington, DC
city.regionLabel: Washington, DC, Northern Virginia, suburban Maryland and a sensible drive
city.coreLabel: DC / Northern Virginia / suburban Maryland core

events.title: Olivia Rodrigo: The Unraveled Tour
events.description: Two-night DC run of the three-time Grammy winner's Unraveled Tour in support of her third album, with doors at 6:00 PM. The arena lists both nights as on sale.

events.title: Olivia Rodrigo: The Unraveled Tour
events.description: Two-night DC run of the three-time Grammy winner's Unraveled Tour in support of her third album, with doors at 6:00 PM. The arena lists both nights as on sale.

events.title: Come From Away at Ford's Theatre
events.description: Tony-winning musical about the Newfoundland town that sheltered 6,579 stranded airline passengers on 9/11; 1 hour 45 minutes, no intermission. Extended through Oct 25.

events.title: Come From Away at Ford's Theatre
events.description: Tony-winning musical about the Newfoundland town that sheltered 6,579 stranded airline passengers on 9/11; 1 hour 45 minutes, no intermission. Extended through Oct 25.

events.title: Maryland Renaissance Festival
events.priceLabel: $31 adult / $17 child (7–15), plus 10% tax and fee
events.description: Elizabethan village with jousting, live music, artisan crafts and food on the festival grounds. Tickets are sold online only (no gate sales) and the festival regularly sells out.

events.title: Cox Farms Fall Festival
events.description: Giant slides, famous hayrides, rope swings, farm animals, cornfield adventures and apples and cider across 90+ acres. Last entry 5 PM; tickets are online only and weekends often sell out.

events.title: Smithsonian American Art Museum: Nick Cave: Mammoth and Much Here Is Beautiful
events.address: 8th and G Streets NW, Washington, DC 20004
events.description: Nick Cave's monumental Mammoth installation (through Jan 3, 2027) and a Bicentennial-era photography survey (through Apr 18, 2027), plus Shahzia Sikander's video The Last Post. Open until 7 PM both days, no tickets needed.

events.title: Baltimore Ravens vs. Tennessee Titans
events.description: Ravens host the Titans in a Week 4 NFL game at M&T Bank Stadium; the team schedule shows it as the only Ravens home game in October before Oct 25.

events.title: Takoma Park Street Festival
events.description: Long-running neighborhood street fair with 185+ vendor booths, live music from 18 local bands and food trucks. Rain or shine, three blocks from Takoma Metro (Red Line).

events.title: Indigo Girls with Linda Perry (seated show)
events.description: The Grammy-winning folk-rock duo plays a seated show spanning their 35-year career, with Linda Perry as special guest; doors at 5:30 PM on the Wharf.

events.title: Foxfield Fall Races
events.description: Charlottesville's signature steeplechase day with tailgating, color-coded parking areas and a first race at noon; gates open at 9:30 AM.

events.title: Brian Cox in The Score at Shakespeare Theatre Company
events.description: US premiere of Trevor Nunn's play with Brian Cox as J.S. Bach facing Frederick the Great's challenge in 1747; about 2.5 hours with intermission. Currently running through at least Oct 18.

events.title: Brian Cox in The Score at Shakespeare Theatre Company
events.description: US premiere of Trevor Nunn's play with Brian Cox as J.S. Bach facing Frederick the Great's challenge in 1747; about 2.5 hours with intermission. Currently running through at least Oct 18.

events.title: Vienna Oktoberfest
events.description: Northern Virginia's big Oktoberfest on Church Street with beer and wine, food vendors, music on multiple stages and a kids zone. Rain or shine, Saturday only.

events.title: Butler's Orchard Pumpkin Festival
events.description: 46th annual pumpkin festival with pick-your-own pumpkins, hayrides, corn maze, jump pads and barnyard animals. Last entry 4:30 PM; advance reservations strongly encouraged as weekends sell out.

events.title: Great Country Farms Fall Pumpkin Harvest
events.description: Pick-your-own pumpkins, a 1.5-acre corn maze, 15-acre play area, pig races, cider pressing and live music. Last pumpkin wagon leaves at 4 PM.

events.title: McLean Artfest
events.description: Outdoor art festival with more than 30 regional visual artists, a Children's Art Walk, food vendors, a beer and wine garden and live music from DC-area musicians.

events.title: Venus at Woolly Mammoth Theatre Company
events.description: World premiere dark comedy by Steve Yockey about a cosmic worst-first-date, starring Kimberly Gilbert and Regina Aquino; 90 minutes, no intermission. Final weekend, closes Oct 4.

events.title: Venus at Woolly Mammoth Theatre Company
events.description: World premiere dark comedy by Steve Yockey about a cosmic worst-first-date, starring Kimberly Gilbert and Regina Aquino; 90 minutes, no intermission. Final weekend, closes Oct 4.

events.title: Dirty Dancing: The Musical
events.description: Stage version of the classic film with live music from the original soundtrack; 2 hours 20 minutes with intermission. Final weekend, run ends Sunday Oct 4.

events.title: Dirty Dancing: The Musical
events.description: Stage version of the classic film with live music from the original soundtrack; 2 hours 20 minutes with intermission. Final weekend, run ends Sunday Oct 4.

events.title: National Museum of Women in the Arts: Routed West quilts (free first Sunday)
events.venue: National Museum of Women in the Arts
events.address: 1250 New York Ave NW, Washington, DC 20005
events.description: Routed West features nearly 80 artworks by African American quilters with Bay Area ties (through Jan 17, 2027), alongside Marlo Pascual and the Remix collection show. Admission is free on the first Sunday of each month.
events.sourceName: National Museum of Women in the Arts

events.title: National Building Museum exhibitions
events.description: Current shows include Coming Together, Brick City, Visible Vault, The Tuskegee Chapel: Paul Rudolph X Fry & Welch and A South Forty on contemporary Southern architecture. The soaring Great Hall is always free.

events.title: U.S. Botanic Garden Conservatory
events.description: Free glass conservatory with tropical, desert and orchid collections beside the Capitol, plus the Fierce Flora plant-defenses exhibit. No tickets required.

events.title: Smithsonian's National Zoo
events.description: Free admission to the zoo grounds; grounds open 8 AM to 4 PM with last entry at 3 PM and animal buildings from 9 AM. Free entry passes must be reserved online for every guest.

events.title: DC Coffee Festival
events.description: Immersive coffee festival with specialty roasters and coffee shops, unique beans, snacks and live entertainment at Dock 5 in Union Market.

events.title: DC Coffee Festival
events.description: Immersive coffee festival with specialty roasters and coffee shops, unique beans, snacks and live entertainment at Dock 5 in Union Market.

events.title: Tinkerfest at the National Children's Museum
events.description: Museum-wide celebration of STEAM with interactive activities, live demonstrations and tinkering stations from partner organizations.

events.title: Somewhere Over the Border at Mosaic Theater
events.venue: Atlas Performing Arts Center (Mosaic Theater Company)
events.description: DC-premiere musical reimagining of The Wizard of Oz with Latin music styles, extended by popular demand through Oct 18 at the Atlas on H Street.

events.title: Somewhere Over the Border at Mosaic Theater
events.venue: Atlas Performing Arts Center (Mosaic Theater Company)
events.description: DC-premiere musical reimagining of The Wizard of Oz with Latin music styles, extended by popular demand through Oct 18 at the Atlas on H Street.

events.title: Knocked Loose and Denzel Curry with Superheaven and Boundaries
events.description: Hardcore heavyweights Knocked Loose co-headline with rapper Denzel Curry, with Superheaven and Boundaries opening; doors at 5:30 PM at the waterfront Anthem.

events.title: The California Honeydrops: Sweet Like That Tour
events.description: The Oakland roots-soul band brings its Sweet Like That Tour to the 9:30 Club with Jontavious Willis; doors at 8:00 PM, music at 9:00 PM.

events.title: Meduza3 at Echostage
events.address: 2135 Queens Chapel Road NE, Washington, DC 20018
events.description: Electronic music night at DC's big warehouse-style club with Meduza headlining and JOA and ALDOR in support; doors and show both at 10:00 PM.

events.title: DJ Shadow Celebrates 30 Years of Endtroducing
events.description: DJ Shadow marks 30 years of his landmark sampling album Endtroducing at the Fillmore in downtown Silver Spring.

events.title: Baltimore Symphony Orchestra: Stravinsky & Prokofiev with Heyward
events.description: Season-opening program with pianist Bruce Liu playing Prokofiev's Piano Concerto No. 3, plus Stravinsky's Firebird Suite and Glinka's Ruslan and Lyudmila Overture, conducted by Jonathon Heyward.

events.title: Maria Bamford
events.description: Stand-up comedian Maria Bamford, known for her offbeat, confessional style, performs one night at the historic Warner Theatre downtown.

events.title: Fahim Anwar at DC Improv
events.description: Comedian Fahim Anwar headlines the main room Saturday night with two shows. There is a two-item food or drink minimum.

events.title: Home Rule Music Festival, Part Two
events.address: 227 Harry Thomas Way NE, Washington, DC 20002
events.description: Free nine-hour celebration of DC's musical heritage with go-go, jazz, hip-hop and soul, plus a kids' zone, live art, a record fair and food trucks.

events.title: Eastern Market Weekend Outdoor Market
events.description: Capitol Hill's weekend outdoor market with farmers, a flea market and arts and crafts vendors around the historic market hall.

events.title: FRESHFARM Dupont Circle Market
events.description: Year-round Sunday farmers market with regional produce, baked goods, cheeses, meats and flowers from local farmers near Dupont Circle.

events.title: PIKEtoberfest
events.address: 11580 Old Georgetown Road, North Bethesda, MD 20852
events.description: Free Sunday fall party with live band and DJ, craft beer and food from neighborhood restaurants, an outdoor makers market, kids activities and dogs welcome.

events.title: National Apple Harvest Festival (first weekend)
events.description: Long-running Pennsylvania apple country festival with hundreds of vendor booths, live entertainment, artisan demonstrations, kids activities and agricultural exhibits; admission includes parking and shuttle.

events.title: 2nd Street Festival, Jackson Ward
events.description: Free two-day street festival in its 38th year with three stages of live music, a Kidz Zone, food vendors, a marketplace, Artists Row and an antique car club show.

events.title: Blessing of the Animals at Washington National Cathedral
events.description: Bring your dog, cat, bunny or other pet to Walker Court for a short blessing service in the cathedral's annual tradition, with Dean Hollerith taking part. Runs 2:00-3:00 PM.

events.title: Serbfest DC Fall 2026
events.description: Church festival with grilled Serbian meats, pastries and soups, traditional cultural performances and family activities, with live tamburitza music by Orkestar Meraklije both days.

events.title: Serbfest DC Fall 2026
events.description: Church festival with grilled Serbian meats, pastries and soups, traditional cultural performances and family activities, with live tamburitza music by Orkestar Meraklije both days.

events.title: Brunswick Railroad Days (43rd annual)
events.description: Small-town railroad heritage festival with model train displays, artisan crafts, food, kids' activities and live music, plus a free park-and-ride shuttle. Sunday's main stage features The Reagan Years, an 80s tribute band, 2-5 PM.

events.title: Birchmere: #IMOMSOHARD - The Crashing Out Tour
events.description: The Birchmere's Saturday-night listing is #IMOMSOHARD with The Crashing Out Tour at 7:30 PM, with tickets through Ticketmaster.

events.title: Sounds in the Square at The Wharf
events.address: Wharf Street SW (Market Square), Washington, DC 20024
events.description: Live music in Market Square on the Southwest waterfront, part of The Wharf's Sunday afternoon series on select Sundays.

events.title: Homes of the Southwest Waterfront Tour (9th annual)
events.address: Southwest Washington, DC (starts at St. Augustine's Church)
events.description: Self-guided walking tour of Southwest DC homes celebrating the neighborhood's architecture, design and views, starting at St. Augustine's Church. Listed by The Wharf; hosted by Waterfront Village.

events.title: Planet Word Museum
events.description: Interactive museum of language housed in the historic Franklin School, with immersive galleries about words, speech and wordplay. Open Sundays 10 AM-6 PM; passes can be reserved online.

events.title: International Spy Museum
events.description: Six permanent galleries on codes, ciphers and famous spies plus the immersive exhibition Camouflage: Designed to Deceive. Tickets are booked through the museum's calendar.

events.title: National Air and Space Museum (free timed-entry passes)
events.description: Free admission with required timed-entry passes reserved in advance; galleries include the Wright Flyer, Apollo 11 artifacts and multiple aviation and spaceflight exhibits.
events.sourceName: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum

events.title: Glenstone Museum (free timed tickets)
events.description: Free art museum and sculpture landscape in Potomac with Pavilions rooms by Cy Twombly, Jasper Johns, Michael Heizer and Brice Marden plus the Gallery show Ties of our common kindred. Open Thursday-Sunday; last ticketed admission 3:15 PM.

events.title: Old Town North Farmers' Market (Sunday)
events.description: Dog-friendly year-round Sunday farmers' market in Alexandria's Old Town North with local farm produce, baked goods, gifts and take-home meals.

events.title: West End Farmers' Market (Sunday)
events.description: City of Alexandria's year-round Sunday farmers' market at Ben Brenman Park on the West End, running 8:30 AM to 1 PM.

events.title: George Washington's Mount Vernon
events.address: 3200 Mount Vernon Memorial Highway, Mount Vernon, VA 22121
events.description: Tour Washington's Potomac River mansion, gardens, museum and grounds; the estate keeps April-October hours of 9 AM-5 PM. Mansion entry requires a ticket bought online or at the gate.

events.title: Haunt: Dark Encounters haunted trail
events.description: Timed-entry immersive haunted trail through the woods built around a mystery of five friends vanishing in 1996, opening night Saturday Oct 3 at the Workhouse Arts Center, with a new after-dark Cell Block tour.

events.title: Laurel's House of Horror
events.description: Walk-through haunted house with four themed areas, including The Carlisle Hotel and The Midnight Hour, plus escape rooms; this is billed as the last season at its current location.
